name: Kinzao

queries.query: Kinzao Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral map parcel official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Land Affairs and its published list of land-registration districts, including Seke-Banza in Kongo-Central. The BIC cadastral portal was also found, but its landing page states service availability for North-Kivu and South-Kivu only. No Kinzao parcel viewer or public ID-plus-geometry service was identified.

queries.query: Kinzao République démocratique du Congo cadastre parcelle carte officielle
queries.result: Les sources officielles du Ministère des Affaires Foncières recensent la circonscription foncière de Seke-Banza dans la province du Kongo-Central et publient une procédure de demande de recherche foncière. La plateforme BIC annonce un cadastre numérique, mais sa page publique indique une disponibilité pour le Nord-Kivu et le Sud-Kivu. Aucun service public anonyme renvoyant un identifiant parcellaire sûr et une géométrie pour Kinzao n'a été qualifié.

registryCustodian.name: Ministère des Affaires Foncières — Circonscription foncière de Seke-Banza
registryCustodian.scope: Official national land-affairs ministry directory identifies Seke-Banza as a Kongo-Central land-registration district. The directory is district-level evidence, not Kinzao parcel coverage or a local parcel API.

localCustodianContext.name: Chef de Division du Cadastre / Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers for the applicable Seke-Banza district
localCustodianContext.scope: The ministry's official request workflow names the cadastral division chief and land-title registrar as the custodians for formal land-record searches; no request was submitted because it requires identity and supporting documents.

service.name: BIC — Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales public portal; Ministry land-affairs request workflow
service.viewerConfiguration: The BIC HTML loaded a current JavaScript bundle. The bundle exposed a public Supabase project and home-bic-counts function, but no usable anonymous parcel map route was exposed in the inspected bundle. The portal landing text advertises cadastral data and says the service is available for North-Kivu and South-Kivu, not Kongo-Central.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Anonymous landing page loaded over verified TLS. The page referenced /assets/index-BrUTiL_J.js; no parcel geometry was present in the HTML.
Current JavaScript/configuration bundle downloaded and inspected. It exposed the public Supabase project URL and a home-bic-counts function, but no qualified public parcel feature endpoint or CRS.
Returned aggregate counts {parcels_count:1, services_count:3, disputes_count:0}; this is not a parcel feature response and has no city, parcel ID, or geometry.
Supabase PostgREST returned PGRST205: public.parcels was not found in the schema cache. No parcel schema, native ID, geometry, or CRS was obtained.
Supabase PostgREST returned PGRST205: public.administrative_units was not found in the schema cache. No administrative or parcel geometry response was obtained.
Official ministry directory loaded and listed Seke-Banza among 11 Kongo-Central land-registration districts. This establishes a district custodian context, not citywide Kinzao parcel coverage.
Official request workflow loaded. It requires requester identity, documents, and a formal land search; no form submission or protected record lookup was attempted.
